policy.default: fullscreen; accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture
fullscreen; accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture

description.description: A description of the map. Can be used in social networks when sharing a link to the map.

copyright.description: Copyright notice for this map. Can be a link to a license. Parts of this map like tilesets or images can have their own copyright.

thumbnail.description: URL to a thumbnail image. This image will be used in social networks when sharing a link to the map.

areasSearchable.description: Number of areas define as searchable by the map editor for the exploration mode.

entitiesSearchable.description: Number of entities define as searchable by the map editor for the exploration mode.

metadata.description: Contains metadata about the map (name, description, copyright, etc.)

vendor.description: Use this field to store data that is not handled directly by WorkAdventure. This is a good place to store data generated by an admin (like access rights)
